note: Cases are the oracle of the retired validate_os_grants (orbital-compiler tests/host_effects_validation.rs `os_grants::`, archived): the kernel's program/os-grants findings (the answers of the Rust host, core base os_grants::static_check tests) become ORB_OS_GRANT_MISSING / _UNUSED / _ENTRY_INVALID and ORB_OS_TARGET_NOT_STATIC at the site the kernel names; the finished-program pass answers as the rule os-grants-final.

findings.message: `os/read-file` argument 1 is computed — an `os/` target must be a literal so the grant can be checked at build time
findings.suggestion: Write the path, command, host, port or name as a literal; a file path may instead be a `str/concat` that starts with a literal or `@config.<knob>` directory ending in `/`, covered by an fs grant ending in `/**`, or an anchored path `{ anchor: "cwd" path: … }` (anchors `exe-dir`, `cwd`, `{ env: "NAME" }`) covered by an anchored grant such as `fs: { cwd: "docs/**": [read] }`; a host or port may be `{ anchor: { env: "PORT" } }` covered by `net: { env HOST, env PORT: [listen] }`
